errors.evidence: In the "Внос" panel, the dotted line for EU starts at approximately 58% in 2004, which is closer to 60% than the middle of 50% (55%).

errors.text_span: Прекъснатата линия за ОИСР (без членки на ЕС) е приблизително между 29% и 48%: започва около ниските 30% през 2004 г.
errors.evidence: The description mistakenly uses the data for the 'ОИСР (без членки на ЕС)' series from the "Износ" panel to describe the same series in the "Внос" panel. The text describes a starting point of 'около ниските 30%' (~33%) and a range of '29% и 48%', which corresponds to the 'Износ' panel, not the 'Внос' panel where the line starts around 22% and has a range of approximately 22%-28%.
